selection.basis: Both standard-review MiMo harnesses delivered 14/15 correct development headline outcomes and 6/6 explicit decision checks. Flash conservative cost was 0.0806071 USD versus Pro 0.0903511 USD on those 15 cases. This is not a full-semantic or forecasting win.
selection.semantic_veto: Neither clears major-decision readiness. Flash reversed the recovery effect on the break-even threshold and misstated posterior odds despite correct checked values. Pro exposed a false upper bound in withheld-review diagnostics and overstated what a single resolution reveals about dependence. Correct scalars do not certify explanations.
selection.thinking_review: Pro thinking review delivered 6/6 headlines but 5/6 checked outputs versus standard 6/6; common-cause evaluation used the wrong fence. Fresh drafts make this a small configuration-level ablation, not an isolated critic experiment. No reliable substantive improvement established; retain standard.

last_source_adjustment: Only the final withholding presentation changed after the last development replay: review objections are explicitly unverified diagnostics, not established facts or validated corrections; the extracted rule is not claimed to be a proven faithful extraction. Requests, approval logic and mathematical outputs unchanged. Actual failure-path smoke and all 36 core tests plus build passed before freeze.
interpretation: One fixed transfer run per model; retain every row, error and abstention. No transfer-driven changes. Local synthetic transfer is not prospective prediction, an independent preregistration or a global leaderboard. Matched output ceilings are not matched actual compute or cost.
